text: A familiar follows you, waits where you tell it, never despawns and sheds double reagent when brushed.

Craft it from **two Spiritweave**, a **Spirit Shard** and **one creature reagent**: Dawn Velvet, Lantern Down, Mossback Scale, Prism Carapace, Rift Tooth, Cinder Knot, Storm Wing, Bell Fragment or Echo Silk.
Any one of them works, and the finished charm bonds any creature that will answer, whichever reagent went in. Brush a gentle animal for its reagent, or take one from a fallen remnant.
pages.title: The Bonding Charm

text: Every creature carries five threads: **Frame** (health), **Stride** (speed), **Fang** (damage), **Hum** (how often its gift works) and **Keep** (armour). Each step up or down is worth 12%.
**Sneak and look at any March creature** to see its threads, its Marks, its generation and its **bloodline**, the five threads added up. Your own companions show theirs whenever you look at them.
Wild threads roll 0 to 3, so two foxes from the same clearing are not clones. Only breeding reaches 4, and the **Exalted** 5. Choose the one you want to keep: bonding never rerolls anything.
pages.title: Read it first

text: There are two ways to bond an adult. Young ones cannot be bonded.

- **Feed it**, the way you would win over a wolf. Gentle animals take their usual food and bond about one time in three; remnants take their own reagent and bond one time in five. Every try spends the food.
- **The Bonding Charm** is quicker: three tries in five for gentle animals, two in five for remnants. A failed charm is only spent on a remnant.
Remnants need **Voice** standing (800) with their tribe either way. Hearts mean it worked; smoke means it did not. Ashbound, Rootbound, Reed Stalkers and Hollow Sentinels never answer.
Feed a hurt companion its food to heal it.
pages.title: Bonding

text: - Shardback: the **Grit-singers**.
- Rift Hound: the **Edge-walkers**.
- Cinder Imp: the **Drumhearts**.
- Storm Moth: the **Pattern-weavers**.
- Mourning Bell: the **Seal-carvers**.
- Echo Weaver: the **Loom-stitchers**.
See [standing](standing) for how to earn it.
pages.title: Which tribe for which remnant

text: A familiar follows once you are **10 blocks** away and teleports to you past **12**. Sneak-use it to make it wait, and again to call it back. It never despawns and ignores your blows.
**One fighter** (a Shardback or Rift Hound) and **two helpers** may follow at once. Sitters and anything being ridden do not count. Extras sit down and tell you why.
A waiting familiar that gets hurt stands up and follows, if there is room in your company.
pages.title: Keeping company

text: Breed two bonded companions of the same species by feeding both their food while they stand close. As with wolves, the young of two companions you own are **born into your company**, and more food helps them grow.
Each child takes one half of every thread from each parent, sometimes nudged up or down. Pairs you own together improve a little more often.

**Breed strong to strong.** When both parents are 3 or better in a thread, the child has a one-in-four chance to go a step higher than either, which is the only way to 4 and the Exalted 5. A line bred with care ends up far stronger than anything wild.
Careful with copying: breeding the same Frame and Fang three generations running under one owner **Frays** the line and lowers its Hum.
pages.title: Breeding better threads

text: Marks are named quirks. Some show with one copy; the rest need a copy from both parents.

- One copy: **Quiet Thread** (follows from 8 blocks, stops at 2), **Stonehide** (+1 armour, a little slower), **Drift** (quicker, 2 less health, gets restless after a minute of waiting), **Soft Maw** (will not bite villagers or golems), **Glow-vein** (fox), **Brace** (Shardback).

- Two copies: **Keen** (gift works faster), **Night Hum** (faster at night), **Kin Mark** (born to one owner's pair, a touch more armour), and the species marks **Leap**, **Deep Pocket**, **Track**, **Tempo**, **Click-true**, **Still** and **Gather**.
A few March-born wild creatures are **Sparked**: they glitter, and carry a strong copy of the thread their species leans toward.
pages.title: Marks
Healing a familiar
text: Besides its favourite food, a hurt familiar can be healed by laying a [salve](remedies) on it (use the salve on it), by standing in burning incense, or by the [Healer's Rattle](healers_rattle).
If one falls, it leaves a **Spirit Remnant**. A [Healing Circle](healing_circle) calls it back.

pages.text: Any one of the nine creature reagents fills the middle slot.
